dct_description_sm: Contained within the National Parks, 1961 to 1994, Atlas of Canada series, is a map that shows Elk Island National Park. This bilingual map shows general reference data for the general area. The map was based on large-scale Alberta topographic maps; their topographic data is shown in metric form (with a contour interval of 10 metres). Shaded relief is used on the map. The map contains data of particular interest to park visitors such as detail about trails and campgrounds.
